title: GitHub Copilot for JetBrains 1.0.1
body_markdown:
### Added

* 1.0.1, our first public release

### Fixed

* Completions appeared at the wrong position after accepting lookup items, which also modified the document before the cursor position.
* Several causes of exception `NullPointerException`.
* Fixed a possible cause of `ClassNotFoundException`.
body_html:
Added

  • 1.0.1, our first public release

Fixed

  • Completions appeared at the wrong position after accepting lookup items, which also modified the document before the cursor position.
  • Several causes of exception NullPointerException.
  • Fixed a possible cause of ClassNotFoundException.
